metrics.accuracy_scored: only items where gt AND pred are both not 'unknown'; fraction that match
metrics.accuracy_gt_known: all items with gt != 'unknown'; pred must match gt (unknown pred = wrong)
metrics.unknown_rate: fraction of gt-known items where prediction is 'unknown'
metrics.by_task: same metrics split by labels task (crosswalk_signal, stairs, obstacles)
metrics.n_gen_tokens: count of token ids passed to decode after generate()
